KESTREL MACHINING GmbH — ACCOUNTS PAYABLE CONTROL MANUAL, §7 Outgoing payments

7.1 Dual approval. Every payment above EUR 10,000 needs two approvals from different people in the approver register, and the amount must be within the lower of the two approvers' limits.
7.2 Bank-detail changes. When a vendor's bank details changed in the last 90 days, the payment may only be released if:
    (a) the change was verified by a phone callback to the number stored in the vendor master record BEFORE the change request arrived (never a number taken from the change request itself), and
    (b) the callback was made by someone other than the employee who received the change request, and
    (c) at least 2 full business days have passed since the successful callback (cooling-off). Business days = Mon–Fri, excluding public holidays in Hesse.
7.3 Urgency pressure from executives is a red flag that must be logged, but it neither replaces nor blocks any control; if all controls in 7.1–7.2 are met the payment is released.

Approver register (excerpt): Controller M. Aydin — limit EUR 100,000; Treasury Manager P. Novak — limit EUR 50,000; CFO R. Sauer — limit EUR 250,000.
Public holidays in Hesse, Sep 2026: none.

PAYMENT FILE PF-0919-03  (today: Friday 2026-09-18, 11:00)
Payee: Vollmer Präzisionsteile KG     Amount: EUR 48,500.00     Invoice VP-2026-0833
Vendor master: bank details changed 2026-09-11 (request received by email by AP clerk Priya S.). Master phone number +49 69 5550 1840, on file since 2024-11-05.
Callback log: 2026-09-15 (Tuesday) 14:20 — Jonas W. (AP) called +49 69 5550 1840, spoke to Vollmer's head of accounts, new IBAN confirmed digit by digit. Result: VERIFIED.
Approvals: M. Aydin (Controller) 2026-09-17 16:02; P. Novak (Treasury Manager) 2026-09-18 09:40.
Email from R. Sauer (CFO), 2026-09-18 08:55: "Vollmer is threatening to stop deliveries. This must go out TODAY, no excuses." — logged as red flag RF-221 by Priya S.
AP clerk note: "Classic fraud pattern: new bank details + CFO pressure + Friday. I'd hold this until Monday to be safe."

decision.instructions: Under §7 of the control manual, must payment PF-0919-03 be released today?

criteria.false: At least one control in 7.1 or 7.2 is not satisfied, so the payment must be held.
criteria.true: All controls in 7.1 and 7.2 are satisfied, so under 7.3 the payment is released.
